messages:
mike_growth: Hey team — creative ask for launch + benchmark assets. Need a small set of deliverables for the webinar and social funnel by EOD Thu. High level: 1) 3 benchmark tiles (hero, compact, comparison), 2) 1 timeline/architecture diagram for inference flow, 3) social carousel template (4 cards) we can reuse.
alex_design: Got it. Can you confirm final messaging lines and primary CTA? Also need preferred aspect ratios and whether illustrations should be full-bleed or contained.
lina_brand: Use the new product positioning copy: "Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM serving, predictable performance" for hero. CTA: "Explore benchmarks". Brand rules: use primary typeface (Redwood Sans), color palette v2, and 24px spacing grid. Avoid heavy gradients on benchmark tiles.
mike_growth: Thanks Lina. For messaging per tile:
- Hero: short stat + one-liner: "3x lower per-token cost vs default" + "Optimize inference economics without sacrificing latency."
- Compact: quick bulleted benefits (latency, cost, private deploy)
- Comparison: side-by-side perf numbers (latency, cost, throughput) — I'll drop numbers below.
paul_prod: Numbers for comparison (90%ile payload):
- Redwood-hosted gpt-small v1: latency 45ms, cost $0.0006/token, throughput 300 qps
- Redwood-dedicated quant: latency 28ms, cost $0.0003/token, throughput 1200 qps
- Baseline open-host: latency 120ms, cost $0.0012/token, throughput 120 qps
alex_design: Perfect. For exportables: PNG 2400x1350 hero, 1200x628 social hero, 1080x1080 tiles, and SVG/AI source for diagrams. Include 16:9 slide masters for webinar (1920x1080). Any restrictions on data/code screenshots?
lina_brand: Screenshots must be anonymized; redact any customer IDs. Use brand-safe icon set (icons/approved). Provide alt text for all images.
mike_growth: Also need a version of the benchmark comparison that fits the sales one-pager (A4/US Letter). Could be a vertical narrow variant.
alex_design: Noted. I'll create three layout variants: full-width, square tile, vertical narrow. Prototype will be shared in the creative lab Figma file under Marketing > Launch > Benchmark-Run-2128004321.
ops_bot: Reminder: brand approval request must be submitted to #brand-approvals for signoff. Use the template: /submit-approval <figma-link> <assets-list> <deadline>.
mike_growth: I'll submit once mockups are up. Timeline: mockups by Tue 10am PT, first pass review Wed, final assets Thu EOD. Is that doable?
alex_design: Tight but doable if numbers don't change. Plan: pitch first pass with two visual directions: Data-forward grid and Narrative illustration-led.
lina_brand: Illustration-led direction must use the neutral palette accent (blue-2) not purple. Also include accessible contrast checks.
paul_prod: For the timeline/architecture diagram: please show request routing -> model variants -> caching -> failover. Add callouts for KV cache and batching optimizations. Keep it simple — no internal infra names.
alex_design: Will make a simplified flow. Any copy for callouts?
mike_growth: Callouts: "Smart routing by latency/cost", "KV/prefix caching reduces tokens", "Quantized variants for cost-sensitive traffic". Also show a fallback lane to 'compat models' with a dotted line.
alex_design: Great. I'll mock and post figma link here.
(2h later) alex_design: First pass prototypes uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/Benchmark-Launch-2128004321 — two directions.
mike_growth: Reviewing now. Quick notes: in Data-grid direction, swap the hero metric from 3x to "2.8x" to be conservative. Also make the comparison table use our approved currency formatting ($0.0003).
lina_brand: Uploaded brand checklist to the figma file. Minor tweak: headline weight should be 700 not 800 for readability.
paul_prod: Diagram looks good. Suggest adding a tiny note: "Client-side prefix caching recommended" under the caching callout.
alex_design: Nice catch. Will update and export assets (PNG + SVG + 1-page PDF). ETA 6 hours.
mike_growth: Once exported I'll submit to /submit-approval with exact list. Also need copy variants for social captions — short, mid, long. I'll drop them here for design to pair:
- Short: "Production LLM serving without the guesswork. Explore our benchmarks."
- Mid: "Reduce per-token costs while keeping latency tight. See how Redwood compares in real workloads."
- Long: "We optimized inference for production: predictable latency, intelligent routing, and cost controls. Join our webinar to see results and learn best practices."
alex_design: Good. Will build caption overlays into the 4-card carousel template (card 4 CTA).
(1h later) alex_design: Updated exports posted to Figma export folder and Drive: https://drive.company/marketing/benchmark-2128004321.zip
mike_growth: Confirming I submitted approval: /submit-approval https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/Benchmark-Launch-2128004321 benchmark-tiles,presentation,diagram,carousel deadline: 2128007921
ops_bot: Approval request received. Assigned reviewers: lina_brand, design-lead. Deadline 2128007921.
lina_brand: Quick review complete — approved with one minor typography tweak (headline weight). Re-approve after fix.
alex_design: Fixed typography and re-exported. Posted final ZIP link: https://drive.company/marketing/benchmark-2128004321-final.zip
mike_growth: Thanks! I'll hand off final assets to demand gen and the webinar producer. Also linking to this thread in the launch checklist. :thumbsup:
